news.title: Judge overturns Trump policies targeting travel ban nationals
news.summary_en: A judge has ruled the US government acted unlawfully in barring travel ban nationals from receiving decisions on applications for changes of visa status including OPT authorisation, green cards and work permits.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Duolingo launches new ear-scanning technology at DETcon
news.summary_en: The Duolingo English Test (DET) has revealed its patent-pending ear scan technology that uses the DET’s mobile app to detect hidden earbuds being used to cheat exams.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: IDP Australia outsources onshore visa services to Bravo Migration
news.summary_en: IDP Education and Bravo Migration have announced a new partnership to provide  onshore visa support for international students across Australia.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: MPs slam HOELT as debate over international students continues
news.summary_en: UK politicians have aired their concerns over plans to introduce a fully remote Home Office-backed English language test, suggesting the model exposes the country to a weaker immigration system.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: India steps up bid to reverse brain drain with global researcher scheme
news.summary_en: New initiative seeks to lure Indian-origin researchers home as India looks to strengthen its research ecosystem amid concerns over brain drain and growing global competition for talent.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Bloomsbury Institute sponsor licence suspended
news.summary_en: Bloomsbury Institute’s international student sponsor licence has been suspended by the Home Office.
news.author: Polly Nash
